name: Spotify Keyboard Shortcut Overlay
description: Adds an on-screen overlay showing Spotify keyboard shortcuts for TV remote use

params.code:
var overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.id = 'spotify-shortcuts'; overlay.style.cssText = 'display:none;position:fixed;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:rgba(0,0,0,0.95);border:2px solid #1db954;border-radius:16px;padding:32px 40px;z-index:99999;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;min-width:400px;'; overlay.innerHTML = '

Keyboard Shortcuts

SpacePlay / PauseShift+NNext TrackShift+PPrevious TrackShift+UpVolume UpShift+DownVolume DownSToggle ShuffleRToggle RepeatLLike / UnlikeCtrl+FSearch/Focus Search

Press ? to toggle this overlay

'; document.body.appendChild(overlay); document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === '?') { overlay.style.display = overlay.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none'; } }); return 'shortcuts-overlay-ready';
